The watering rota covers the raised beds and the greenhouse, with an
evening slot every day from May to September. This season's rule
change: whoever waters logs it in the book, because three people
watered on Tuesday and nobody knows who did Wednesday.

Shading, ventilating and clearing the greenhouse rotate weekly along
with the rota. Two volunteers have offered to take the late slot in
exchange for the second half of the plot, which the committee has yet
to approve.
